segments.sn7.22:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati khomadussaṃ nāmaṃ sakyānaṃ nigamo.
segments.sn7.22:1.3: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya khomadussaṃ nigamaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.sn7.22:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā sabhāyaṃ sannipatitā honti kenacideva karaṇīyena, devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati.
segments.sn7.22:1.5: Atha kho bhagavā yena sā sabhā tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn7.22:1.6: Addasaṃsu khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.sn7.22:1.8: “ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā, ke ca sabhādhammaṃ jānissantī”ti?
segments.sn7.22:1.9: Atha kho bhagavā khomadussake brāhmaṇagahapatike gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn7.22:2.2: Santo na te ye na vadanti dhammaṃ;
segments.sn7.22:3.1: Evaṃ vutte, khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn7.22:3.3: seyyathāpi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya – cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti, evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.sn7.22:3.4: Ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.sn7.22:3.5: Upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate”ti.

lines: “mayi evamevaṃ upasaṅkamante aphāsukadhātukaṃ hoti, ekaṃ kāraṇaṃ paṭicca upasaṅkamissāmī”ti adhiṭṭhānavasena vuṭṭhiṃ uppādesi.
Sabhādhammanti sukhanisinne kira asañcāletvā ekapassena pavisanaṃ tesaṃ sabhādhammo nāma, na mahājanaṃ cāletvā ujukameva pavisanaṃ.
Bhagavā ca ujukameva āgacchati, tena te kupitā bhagavantaṃ hīḷentā “ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā, ke ca sabhādhammaṃ jānissantī”ti āhaṃsu.
Pahāyāti ete rāgādayo jahitvā rāgādivinayāya dhammaṃ bhaṇanti, tasmā te santo nāmāti.
Ujukameva āgacchati lokagganāyako bhagavā sabbasattuttamo attano uttaritarassa abhāvato lokassa apacitiṃ na dasseti.
Ye sabbaso saṃkilese pajahanti, teva paṇḍite “santo”ti dasseti “ete”tiādinā.
